newsitem.title: LEBANON: One Israeli soldier killed in south Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: One Israeli soldier killed in south Lebanon.

text.p: One Israeli soldier was killed and three others wounded when Moslem guerrillas attacked their patrol in south Lebanon on Wednesday, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

The guerrillas fired rockets, rocket-propelled grenades and machineguns at the Israeli patrol in Arnoun on the edge of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, the South Lebanon Army (SLA) sources said. One soldier was killed and three wounded, two of them seriously, they added.
Lebanon's pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) claimed responsibility for the attack.

A Hizbollah spokesman in Beirut told Reuters the guerrillas fired at an Israeli patrol in the Arnoun-Zafateh area on the edge of the Israeli-held zone, hitting a military vehicle and killing or wounding those inside.

Hizbollah is leading a guerrilla war to oust some 1,000 Israeli troops and 3,000 SLA militiamen from the 15-km (nine-miles)- deep zone in south Lebanon set up by Israel to stop cross-frontier guerrilla raids on northern Israel.
